newsitem.title: USA: Venezuela prepares to offer about 15 new fields.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela prepares to offer about 15 new fields.

text.p: Venezuela is preparing to open about 15 new oil fields to international bidding by the end of this year, Luis Giusti, president and CEO of Petroleos de Venezuela SA PDVSA said Friday.

Details for the offering of marginal fields were still being discussed, but PDVSA planned to open a total of about 20 properties to private bidders, reserving four or five of them for domestic firms, he said.

"There are four or five fields that will be separated for national companies as part of our policy to develop national capacity for field operations," he said, after speaking at a luncheon hosted by the Johns Hopkins School of Advanced International Studies.
The new bidding round would mark the next step in Venezuela's efforts to invite private investment into its oil inudstry.
Earlier this year, PDVSA signed exploration and production associations with international companies in eight blocks.
